limitations: One proposed bounded parameter; neither variant nor prototype approved for production
Finite probe uses two seeded episodes and a compact structured constructor, not arbitrary all-grid proof or broad diversity claim
Rival identifiability checks cover the two declared settings only
Existing production per-puzzle API remains fixed canonical and is not changed

frequency_extreme.input_constraints: same for both settings: rectangular 5..30 integer-color grid, at least two nonzero colors, selected bbox smaller than full input; constructed episodes have unequal global extremes and demonstrations reject the other setting
frequency_extreme.scope: chosen once per complete episode; inferred from demonstrations
frequency_extreme.semantics: minimum or maximum whole-grid frequency of an object's nonzero color

program_hash_definition: sha256 of emit_rule UTF-8 bytes without trailing newline; .rkt files add one display newline
public_payload_policy: public/*.json contains only train input/output pairs and test inputs; filename/index exposes no setting, seed or rule
